name: academic-cv
title: Draft academic activity CV
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM faculty ORDER BY code

sections.title: Academic
sections.sql: SELECT f.code,f.name,f.role,d.name department FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON d.id=f.department_id WHERE f.id=$1

sections.title: Verified teaching, research and service
sections.sql: SELECT kind,title,occurred_on,reference,evidence FROM activities WHERE faculty_id=$1 AND state='verified' ORDER BY kind,occurred_on DESC
sections.note: Private draft from verified activity records. Review recipients, completeness and permission before sharing.

name: annual-return
title: Annual activity return
for_each: SELECT r.id,f.code || '-' || c.code name FROM annual_returns r JOIN faculty f ON f.id=r.faculty_id JOIN cycles c ON c.id=r.cycle_id ORDER BY name

sections.title: Return record
sections.note: Draft returns show current activity. Submitted and approved returns show the frozen submission.

sections.title: Activity record
sections.sql: SELECT a.kind,a.title,a.occurred_on,a.reference,a.evidence FROM activities a JOIN annual_returns r ON r.faculty_id=a.faculty_id AND r.cycle_id=a.cycle_id WHERE r.id=$1 AND r.state='draft' AND a.state<>'withdrawn' UNION ALL SELECT x.kind,x.title,x.occurred_on::date,x.reference,x.evidence FROM annual_returns r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(r.snapshot->'activities') AS x(kind text,title text,occurred_on text,reference text,evidence text) WHERE r.id=$1 AND r.state<>'draft' ORDER BY kind,occurred_on

name: department-brief
title: Department activity brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM departments ORDER BY code

sections.title: Annual returns
sections.sql: SELECT f.code,f.name,c.code cycle,r.state,c.due_on FROM faculty f JOIN annual_returns r ON r.faculty_id=f.id JOIN cycles c ON c.id=r.cycle_id WHERE f.department_id=$1 ORDER BY f.code,c.code

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: SELECT a.code,f.name,a.kind,a.title FROM activities a JOIN faculty f ON f.id=a.faculty_id WHERE f.department_id=$1 AND a.state='draft' ORDER BY a.code
